remarks: Totally renovated light and bright end-unit townhouse... From the oversized 1-1/4" Nacarado Quartzite kitchen island to the spacious seating area enhanced by a gleaming white cathedral ceiling, wood-burning fireplace and sliders leading to the private, upper deck, this is "a home to love". The dining area is delineated by a bright, bay window with southern exposure and built-in "buffet" which provides storage as well as housing two (2) Subzero refrigerator drawers plus a separate wine cooler. The kitchen is fully applianced and features an induction cooktop as well as other high-end appliances. A second bedroom is currently being used as a den/family room and is located on the main living level adjacent to the full-sized hall bath with stall shower. The lower level features a spacious entry foyer with hall closet, utility rooms, and laundry which also accomodates an oversized sink - perfect for large items as well as pets! The Primary Bedroom Suite has an updated "marble" bath with double sinks, soaking tub, heated towel rack and stall shower. There is a large walk-in closet, additional space for a reading/exercise nook and sliders to a private deck. The attached 1-car garage provides extra storage. Well-located in "easy" East Norwalk, Charles Cove is close to I-95, the East and South Norwalk RR stations, historic SoNo and the SoNo Mall, as well as Westport and other surrounding towns for great dining/shopping and entertainment. 35' Boat Slip also available For Rent.
